items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是窗口内新出现的开源编码智能体运行时讨论。插件化描述和包名可核对，但“杀死行业”是作者判断，发帖账号并非 DeepSeek 官方。
items.abstract_or_text: DeepSeek just killed the coding-agent industry. deepseek-harness: Open-source. Free. Claude Code's top plan costs 200/month. What it does: → Everything is a plugin - model adapters, tools, session logs, even the agent loop itself, all swappable from config → Built on Cordis, DeepSeek's own plugin runtime → One command to run: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
items.summary_zh: ArchiveExplorer 称 DeepSeek 开源了 deepseek-harness：一切皆插件，模型适配器、工具、会话日志乃至智能体循环均可从配置替换，基于 Cordis 运行时，可用 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 一键启动；作者将其与 Claude Code 每月200美元套餐对比。
items.abstract_zh: DeepSeek 刚刚杀死了编码智能体行业。deepseek-harness：开源。免费。Claude Code 最高套餐每月 200 美元。它能做什么：→ 一切皆插件——模型适配器、工具、会话日志，甚至智能体循环本身，都可从配置中替换 → 基于 Cordis，即 DeepSeek 自有的插件运行时 → 一条命令即可运行：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

Ultrafast is designed for businesses where faster frontier intelligence creates a measurable advantage, including real-time voice and customer support, commerce, coding and design, financial research, and security response.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是实验室对开源权重的正式交付，参数量、上下文和许可证均可核对。称整体超过 Qwen3.7-Plus 是官方对比，未见公开对照表。
items.abstract_or_text: We promised open weights for Qwen3.8. Now, time to meet them! ⚡ Qwen3.8-27B: - A native multimodal dense model. With just 27B parameters, it outperforms Qwen3.7-Plus overall and shines in real-world coding & office workflows. - 262K native context, easily extendable to 1M tokens via YaRN. - Built for builders. Highly efficient, high-quality, and licensed under Apache 2.0. 🚀 The open weights for Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B (Max-level) have also been released recently.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 发布 Qwen3.8-27B 开源权重：原生多模态稠密模型，原生上下文 26.2 万 token，可用 YaRN 扩到 100 万，许可证为 Apache 2.0。
items.abstract_zh: 我们承诺过为 Qwen3.8 提供开源权重。现在，来见见它们！Qwen3.8-27B：原生多模态稠密模型。仅 270 亿参数，整体表现超过 Qwen3.7-Plus，并在真实世界编程与办公工作流中表现出色。原生 26.2 万上下文，可通过 YaRN 轻松扩展到 100 万 token。为构建者而做。高效、高质量，并以 Apache 2.0 许可。Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B（Max 级）的开源权重也已于近日发布。
